comments.value: I've reported many people in the past for explicitly stating they're underage and VRChat still hasn't removed their accounts. Seriously can't happen so enough. Its crazy this has gone mostly unanswered for around 5 years atp

VRChat really needs to address this issue. There are far too many young children using the platform unsupervised. I've personally witnessed adults saying and doing extremely inappropriate things toward minors, and there’s not always someone around to intervene. It's disturbing, and it puts these kids in serious danger. We need a better system to report underage users and protect vulnerable players.

It's crazy to me that this still hasn't be implemented in some way. With more players being able to use the mobile app, it's only gonna get worse and worse till VRChat does something about it. Last night, I heard some kid that had to have been 4 or 5 playing this game. It's so gross that this is even a problem that VRC faces.

for players who are falsely reported as minors could give ID identification to prove their an adult or over the age, but in return the person who filed the false claims would have a strike to their name for falsely report. that way it doesn't become an abused system.

I would appreciate an update on the expected timeline for this feature, as well as any details on the current challenges or considerations that are affecting its release.

This post was made 5 years ago, and has been marked as tracked.

We are seeing a slow rollout of changes made to the Community Guidelines (See attachment), but there needs to be a way that users can report accounts suspected of being underaged in the VRChat platform via the in app moderation tools.

I am asking for VRChat to please provide an update to this feature request either via the reply to this Canny, or via the Developer Update patch notes.

This is something that the community clearly cares a lot about, and I speak for myself when I say that I want more transparency so I can feel safer knowing my mature conversations with friends stay far away from minors.

Age verification was a good first step, now we need in game reporting tools incase someone is account sharing, or bypassing identification in some way.

Most forget that each kid has different circumstances, and a parent may not be in the picture.

Its important to remember that, and try and keep kids out of mature spaces.

Be an advocate. Speak up, because change starts with action, even if its annoying to do.

According to VRChat, tracked issues older than a couple of years are not actually being worked on... So I made a new post. pls leave comments here https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/add-underage-reporting

details: I have been around for awhile now in VRC and I have noticed a growing number of children under the ages of 9 and younger coming into the VRC worlds and harassing normal players. I would like to request to add a report under-aged player to the report forms to help deal with these problems and set an understanding that rules must be upheld. Otherwise They're just going to think they can do what ever they wish without consequences and sexual predators are going to attack these children. I have heard such cases in vr already to have happened from others I have met the youngest being 5 years of age.
